messages:
maria: kicking off dev/staging sanity for nova-instruct-7b (q4f16). landing on dev-gpu-3. i ran a quick smoke; posting checklist and short prompts. need someone to run perf/latency and run a small eval set. @aj can you take perf? :wave:

aj: on it. can you paste config and sample queries?

maria: config:
```
model: nova-instruct-7b-q4f16
device: cuda:0
batch_size: 4
max_tokens: 256
quant: q4f16
profile: dev-nova-quick
```
quick prompts:
1) "Summarize the following commit message in one sentence: Added user caching for token lookups to reduce latency."
2) "Translate to French: The meeting is at 3pm."
3) "What is 43*27?"
4) "Write a polite email declining an interview slot at 10am."

carla: added an eval harness run on the small regset (10 prompts) — 9/10 pass heuristics. math failed on #3 (returned 1161? verifying). need numeric precision check and tokenization sanity.

benchy: latency numbers from dev-gpu-3 (p95) warm cache: 85ms, cold start: 210ms, throughput @bsz4: 62 tok/s per GPU. baseline fp16 (non-quant) was 48ms p95 and 80 tok/s. memory footprint reduced ~28%.

aj: thanks — perf looks slightly worse than fp16 for p95 but trades memory. can we try `--kv-cache-split` and `--continuous-batching` flags? i'll spin that up now.

maria: ran quick comparison vs satori-12b-lite on staging — nova wins on short prompts, degrades for >512 tokens. adding regression note to the model card.

devops-bot: autoscaler: noticed increased GPU memory after q4f16 load; autoscaler triggered +1 node (dev-gpu-pool). /cc @infra :information_desk_person:

tyler: i can try different quant knobs. recommend re-run with `--quant-clip 0.02` and `--per-channel false` to see effect on numeric ops.

carla: ran a tokenization check. issue was spacing: '43*27' tokenizes differently than '43 * 27' leading to parsing mismatch in our math detector. i'll normalize inputs in the harness and re-run the small regset.

maria: next steps:
- aj: run continuous-batching + kv-cache test and post p50/p95/p99 + throughput (ETA ~30m)
- tyler: run quant-knob sweep (clip/per-channel) on same harness (ETA ~45m)
- carla: expand regset to +50 edge prompts (math, instruction-following, safety)
- infra/devops: monitor autoscaler behavior during soak
if all green we can schedule a canary to dedicated-night for overnight soak. anyone object?

aj: no objections. i'll post results in this thread. :rocket:

tyler: noted, will ping when new quant run done.

maria: thanks everyone — leaving thread open. tagging @benchy for cost-estimates after aj results are in.
